search_text: published ZDI-24-1682 ZDI-CAN-25394 GeoVision GV-ASManager Missing Authorization Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2024-12-12 CVE-2024-12553 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-12553 6.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['GeoVision'] ['GV-ASManager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of GeoVision GV-ASManager. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, default guest credentials may be used. The specific flaw exists within the GV-ASWeb service. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. title: GeoVision GV-ASManager Missing Authorization Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of GeoVision GV-ASManager. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, default guest credentials may be used. The specific flaw exists within the GV-ASWeb service. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
